_comment: Known, accepted gaps. check_corpus.py fails only on gaps NOT listed here. Remove an entry once it is closed.

missing_sdk_modules.elyxcore: internal module of the ELYX build tool's own runtime, imported inside try/except

missing_sdk_names.client_utils._prepare_document: private helper of exteraGram's client_utils; the one plugin falls back to send_audio
missing_sdk_names.elyx.get_environment: ELYX builder internal, guarded by the plugin

missing_java_classes.com.exteragram.messenger.api.dto.BadgeDT: exteraGram profile badges: PrimeGram draws none, so hooks on them could never fire; plugins guard with find_class
missing_java_classes.com.exteragram.messenger.ai.AiController: exteraGram feature PrimeGram does not have
missing_java_classes.com.exteragram.messenger.drawer.DrawerAc: exteraGram UI internals, reached by reflection to restyle exteraGram's drawer
exteraGram pill stack; PrimeGram's is PrimePillStack with a different model
missing_java_classes.org.telegram.messenger.BuildConfig: generated at build time (VERSION_NAME/VERSION_CODE added in TMessagesProj/build.gradle); not a source file

missing_java_members.TLRPC.TL_keyboardButtonCallback: Telegram 12.10 moved keyboard buttons to tl/TL_keyboard with a new layer; old-layer objects must not be built
missing_java_members.TLRPC.TL_account_updateProfile: moved to TL_account.updateProfile; the plugin uses the new name when present
missing_java_members.TLRPC.TL_inputMessageID: not in Telegram for many releases
missing_java_members.ActionBarPopupWindow.INPUT_METHOD_NOT_NE: inherited from android.widget.PopupWindow; the checker only sees our sources
